1.name: exp
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double exp(int index, double val){return Kokkos::exp(val);}

1.name: log
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double log(int index, double val){return Kokkos::log(val);}

1.name: abs
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double abs(int index, double val){return Kokkos::abs(val);}

1.name: negate
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double negate(int index, double val){return -val;}

1.name: square
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double square(int index, double val){return val * val;}

1.name: sqrt
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double sqrt(int index, double val){return Kokkos::sqrt(val);}

1.name: reciprocal
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double reciprocal(int index, double val){return 1.0 / val;}

1.name: cos
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double cos(int index, double val){return Kokkos::cos(val);}

1.name: relu
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double relu(int index, double val){return (val > 0.0) ? val : 0.0;}

1.name: scale
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double scale(int index, double val, double factor){return factor * val;}

1.name: add_constant
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double add_constant(int index, double val, double c){return val + c;}

1.name: add
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double add(int index, double val1, double val2){return val1 + val2;}

1.name: sub
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double sub(int index, double val1, double val2){return val1 - val2;}

1.name: mul
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double mul(int index, double val1, double val2){return val1 * val2;}

1.name: div
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double div(int index, double val1, double val2){return val1 / val2;}

1.name: power
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double power(int index, double val1, double val2){return Kokkos::pow(val1, val2);}

1.name: modulo
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double modulo(int index, double val1, double val2){return Kokkos::fmod(val1, val2);}

1.name: max
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double max(int index, double val1, double val2){return Kokkos::max(val1, val2);}

1.name: min
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double min(int index, double val1, double val2){return Kokkos::min(val1, val2);}

1.name: greater_than
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double greater_than(int index, double val1, double val2){return (val1 > val2) ? 1.0 : 0.0;}

1.name: less_than
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double less_than(int index, double val1, double val2){return (val1 < val2) ? 1.0 : 0.0;}

1.name: equal
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double equal(int index, double val1, double val2, double eps){return (Kokkos::abs(val1 - val2) < eps) ? 1.0 : 0.0;}

1.name: atan2
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double atan2(int index, double val1, double val2){return Kokkos::atan2(val1, val2);}

1.name: weighted_average
1.impl: KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION double weighted_average(int index, double val1, double val2, double w1, double w2){return (w1 * val1 + w2 * val2) / (w1 + w2);}
